user_problem: People ask recurring questions but do not know which supplied source type is authoritative for each question.
unique_output: A routing guide mapping question patterns to source, acceptable evidence, freshness cue, and fallback when absent.
required_input: Question examples, source inventory, declared authority rules, update dates, and fallback contacts or documents.
critical_rule: Do not declare authority from format or title; use only supplied authority and precedence rules.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is source-note-to-outline; this routes future questions to sources rather than organizing notes into prose.
acceptance_scenario: Input says pricing questions use approved price sheet P, setup steps use handbook H, and conflicts defer to policy O. Output routes each example accordingly and sends a P-versus-O conflict to O.
